Statement: >50% of biodiversity lost this century under business-as-usual
Caveat: >50% is the worst-case upper bound not central estimate

Recovered source: WEF (2023) reporting npj Climate & Atmospheric Science

Statement: Earth always changing; ~5 deg warmer 100000 years ago
Recovered source: No single report; standard paleoclimate talking point

Statement: OBR: cost of Net Zero by 2030 more than £300bn

Statement: 50% of UK energy already from renewables

Statement: Educating migrants' children a drain on resources
